name: About
summary: About page of The Component Gallery: what interface components are, why to build with them, and where the site's examples come from.
description: The Component Gallery is a collection of interface components from real-world design systems, made as a reference for anyone building user interfaces. The page explains what a component is, the benefits of component-based design (consistency, reusability, a shared language), web components vs React/Vue/Angular/Svelte components, design systems vs component libraries, and links resources for making a design system.
